Nora (ML): ran a small FP8 trial on customer endpoint for 24h. Cost down ~22%, p95 latency neutral, but we saw lower entity extraction F1 on Portuguese.
Diego R.: curious if its layer-local or attention-scaling. Any diffs vs INT8?
Nora (ML): diffs concentrated at mid layers 14-18; INT8 run didnt show the same drop.
Sam T.: could be stochastic rounding in fp8 implementation. Do we have token-level logit deltas?
Nora (ML): yes  added token_logit_delta metric; spikes align with mispredicted entities. Plot uploaded: https://redwood.internal/quant/plots/1659994321 (internal).
Diego R.: ops idea: rather than fallback to FP32, do a rapid downgrade to INT8 per-request when avg token-KL > 0.1 in first 32 tokens. Cheaper and likely fixes it.
Sam T.: agree. Also expose a small precision_hint header so clients can request quality-first. Keep default as balance.
ops-bot: scheduled canary rollout (1%) for job 25140.
Nora (ML): action items: Diego to prototype runtime gating (ETA 3d); Sam to add header docs and SDK example (ETA 2d); Ill monitor canary F1 and token_kl metrics.
Diego R.: will implement as middleware to allow hot-toggle.
Sam T.: will include privacy note about token telemetry.
Nora (ML): thanks, will report back after 72h.
